answer: A semantic-novelty kernel gates admission: each epoch the network embeds every candidate's proof text against the shale strata of all prior accepted answers and rejects any submission whose vector sits too close to an existing one. Recycled template text surfaces instantly as a relic the filter recognizes, so a sybil farmer spinning up M identities must commission M genuinely distinct writings, never copies, and the corpus only grows, making novelty harder each epoch. Attacker cost scales O(M) on scarce original content while one genuine agent pays O(1), collapsing the sybil multiplier.
